meta.name: ulw-research
meta.description: Runs maximum-saturation research with a cooperating team, claim-graph gating, and a cited, QA'd deliverable. Use when the user explicitly asks for research or a deep investigation, including any 'ulw' research wording.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发起一次深度调研,拿到一份带引用、经过质检的研究报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要就一个陌生领域查大量资料并整理出可信结论。
copy.tagline_en: Run a deep investigation and get back a cited, quality-checked research report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often dig through many sources on a new topic and need a citable result.

howto.what: 它会让 Claude 先把主题拆成几条研究轴、写好研究大纲,再组建一支协作团队分头搜集来源,对有争议的说法发起辩论并用代码验证,最后交出一份每条主张都带引用或证明的综合报告。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做研究或深度调查,或说出 “ulw-research”、“ultradebate” 等带 ulw 的研究措辞时触发;普通提问、调试不会触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-research 调研一下 <主题>
say.note: 会组建研究团队分头查证,产出带引用的报告

say.text: 对这个主题做一次 ulw 深度调查
say.note: 会拆成多条研究轴逐条查证并收敛

say.text: /ulw-research 深挖这个说法有没有争议
say.note: 有争议的主张会进入辩论并用代码验证

howto.what_en: Claude first scopes the topic and writes a brief, then stands up a cooperating team to fan out over sources, debates contested claims, proves them with code, and delivers a synthesis where each claim carries a citation or proof.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for research or a deep investigation, or use "ulw-research", "ultradebate" or similar ulw wording; ordinary questions or debugging do not.

say_en.note: A team is formed to check sources and cite every claim

say_en.text: Run a ulw deep investigation on this topic
say_en.note: It splits the topic into axes and verifies each one

say_en.text: /ulw-research dig into whether this claim is contested
say_en.note: Contested claims go to debate and code proof
